## Summary

The shared consumer workflow runs the immutable v0.7.0 writer. Its digest resolves to the verified v0.7.0 image that includes #168. Existing callers adopt the new writer by updating their reviewed workflow reference. A caller with an older generated proposal can retain its prior producer in reviewed replay history.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Use the v0.7.0 writer in the shared Rolling Release workflow.
impact: Consumers can adopt verified release capture for individually squashed pull request stacks.
required_action: null
```

## Verification

- v0.7.0 and latest resolve to digest `sha256:83184b69e2992dbd1dcbd4a8ae671a668f19c4bf93e003c4bf216f22e04c028e`. The OCI revision and Git tag both identify `170634fcc1b9614357b8f1acb54fc54276baa85f`.
- The provider published the immutable GitHub release through its normal approval and publication workflow. [Publication run](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/actions/runs/44993243306)

## Risks and limitations

Consumers adopt this change with a reviewed pin update. Rollback uses the previous caller reference and preserves the producers required for proposals that already exist.

## Summary

| Version decision | Default under v2 |
| --- | --- |
| Patch | `build`, `chore`, `ci`, `refactor`, `fix`, `perf`, `revert` |
| Minor | `feat` |
| Carry forward | `docs`, `style`, `test` |

Breaking changes use the existing versioning rule. Trusted callers can override nonbreaking types with `releaseBumps`. New caller templates and preflight use v2. Existing callers keep their configured revision. Historical replay uses the policy captured with the proposal and verifies its exact tagged landing before switching cycles.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Add a release policy that proposes patches for build, chore, CI, and refactor pull requests.
impact: Packaging, dependency maintenance, and workflow fixes can reach consumers without waiting for an unrelated release. Each repository can still tune its own bump rules.
required_action: null
```

## Verification

- The full local hook passed 955 behavioral tests, 22 architecture tests, formatting, lint, types, and the docs build.

- Planning tests cover patch defaults, carry-forward types, partial overrides, and the highest bump in a mixed batch.
- Lifecycle tests replay a v1 predecessor with its original policy, reject edited or incorrectly tagged predecessors, and start the next release under v2.

## Rollout

Upgrade the reviewed preview, writer, and any metadata runtime before switching an existing caller. Finish open proposals under their captured policy and retain the historical producers needed for exact replay.
